articles.title: Sophon sets Nov. 25 withdrawal deadline ahead of mainnet shutdown
articles.snippet: In June, Sophon’s developers said the costs of maintaining a standalone blockchain no longer justified its benefits and announced plans to focus on consumer finance and AI applications on Base.

articles.title: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs Join Growing List of Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
articles.snippet: Sixteen companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, up from nine just four days earlier, according to an updated public notice.

articles.title: French Lawmakers Back Stablecoin Swap Tax by Just One Vote
articles.snippet: The amendment would make swapping crypto into euro or dollar stablecoins taxable in France from 2027, with gains measured coin by coin.
